title: fix: resolve I18nLabel objects in MetricWidget/MetricCard to prevent React error #31
body:
CRM dashboard metric widgets pass I18nLabel objects (`{key, defaultValue}`) for `trend.label`. `MetricWidget` rendered these directly as JSX children, causing React error #31 (objects are not valid as React children).

### Changes

- **`MetricWidget.tsx`** — Added `resolveLabel()` to convert I18nLabel objects to strings before rendering `label`, `description`, and `trend.label`. Widened prop types to accept the union.
- **`MetricCard.tsx`** — Same defensive resolution for `title` and `description`.
- **Tests** — 3 new cases covering I18nLabel resolution in both components and through the dashboard renderer.

### Example

```ts
// crm.dashboard.ts — trend.label is an I18nLabel object, not a string
trend: { value: 12.5, direction: 'up', label: { key: 'crm.dashboard.trendLabel', defaultValue: 'vs last month' } }
```

```tsx
// Before: crashes with React error #31
{description || trend?.label}

// After: resolves to plain string
{resolveLabel(description) || resolveLabel(trend?.label)}
```
